In the placebo-controlled trial, symptoms fell more on aripiprazole than on placebo (p < 0.005 in the text, p < 0.05 in Table 3), with mean CGI-S 2 on aripiprazole and 2.1 on placebo (time point not stated), and more akathisia and agitation on aripiprazole. In the 42-participant aripiprazole–risperidone trial: agitation 52.4% vs 19.0%, akathisia 61.9% vs 28.6%, discontinuation 33% vs 0%; in the olanzapine–haloperidol trial: completers 93.1% vs 65.5%, more extrapyramidal symptoms on haloperidol. The review's conclusion that antipsychotics are efficacious rests on improvement within each arm, and its per-trial SMDs (Table 3) do not state what they compare and partly lack minus signs (study card sc_fluyau_2019, reporting issues 1 to 3).
